meta.title: H. Remigiuskerk in Duiven
meta.description: Activities at the H. Remigiuskerk in Duiven, of the parish of Saint Thomas the Apostle for Chaldeans in the Netherlands.

header.parish: Saint Thomas the Apostle, parish for Chaldeans in the Netherlands

empty.title: Nothing is on the agenda yet
empty.body: There are no activities at the moment. You are welcome to look again later. When there is something to come to, it will be here.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.intro: Entrance is free. Create an account and tell us who is coming. Each person gets their own code.
signup.cancelNote: If you cannot come, cancel on this website or reply to our email. There is no deadline. The euro for a bingo card is not returned automatically.
signup.name: Name
signup.bingoPay: You only pay for the bingo cards.
signup.simulated: On this computer, payment is simulated until Stripe is connected.
signup.paymentsClosed: Payment is not open yet. Please try again later.

errors.account: Create an account first, or log in.
errors.name: Enter a name for each person.
errors.age: Enter an age for each person.
errors.event: This activity is no longer open.
errors.payment: Payment did not work. Please try again later.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

complete.title: You are signed up
complete.waiting: The bank has not confirmed the payment yet. This page refreshes by itself.
complete.body: These are your codes. We also send them to {email}.
complete.cancel: If you cannot come, cancel under My signups, or reply to the email. There is no deadline.
complete.emailPending: The email has not been sent yet. Keep this page, or open your codes with the button below.

account.registerIntro: With an account you sign up for this activity and for activities still to come. Later you can see where you have been.
account.forgotIntro: Enter the email address of your account. We send a link if we know it.
account.name: Name
account.phoneHint: We use this only for the church activities.
account.forgotSent: If we know this email address, we send a link to choose a new password.
account.upcomingEmpty: You are not signed up for anything yet.
account.historyIntro: Activities where you were let in appear here.
account.historyEmpty: Nothing yet. After a visit it appears here.
account.refund: You can cancel until the activity has ended, including on the day itself. The euro for a bingo card is not returned automatically. Reply to our email if you want it back.
account.cancelFailed: This person is already inside, or already cancelled.

errors.credentials: That email address and password do not match.
errors.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a quarter of an hour and try again.
errors.email: Enter an email address we can write to.
errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.password: Choose a password of at least 8 characters.
errors.match: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.taken: There is already an account with this email address. Log in, or choose forgot password.
errors.invalid: This link no longer works. Ask for a new one.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

ticket.title: Your ticket
ticket.intro: Enter the ticket number. That number is also in your email.
ticket.invalid: That number does not belong to this signup.
ticket.barcodeHint: Keep this screen ready at the entrance.
ticket.prize: This ticket has won one of the five prizes.
ticket.bingoPrize: This ticket has won one of the five bingo prizes.
ticket.calledEmpty: The first number will appear here.
ticket.pending: This signup is not paid yet.

bingoLive.title: Bingo
bingoLive.empty: The numbers appear here during the activity.
